title: Staggered compliance calendar and rotating ownership for SOC2/ISO onboarding
creator: Sofia Nguyen
description: Create a staggered milestone calendar and rotating owner model for cross-functional compliance efforts (SOC2/ISO + SSO/SAML + audit log retention). Goal: reduce single-person bottlenecks, make evidence handoffs predictable, and provide a calendar that maps technical deliverables to evidence collection windows and QA gates. This ticket defines cadence, owner rotation rules, blackout windows, escalation paths, and automation hooks for reminders and dashboarding.
acceptance_criteria: A public calendar (Confluence) listing all compliance milestones through 2026-Q3 with owner and backup assigned for each week
Owner-rotation policy documented with onboarding/offboarding checklist and handoff template
Three automation signals created: 14-day reminder to owner, evidence overdue alert, and pre-rollout freeze notification
Runbook for blackout windows and emergency rollback during gated releases published
Integration links to evidence buckets (S3 path), audit-log retention config, and PRD/Design artifacts included
tasks: Draft staggered milestone calendar (PM) and share with Eng/Security for feedback
Design owner-rotation roster and backup assignment rules
Implement Confluence page template and calendar feed
Create reminder automation (PagerDuty webhook + Slack channel) with 14d/3d/1d cadence
Wire evidence pointers: S3 buckets, Vault KMS notes, and retention dashboards
Define gating criteria for release windows and blackout/enforcement policy
Run two pilot weeks with rotated owners and collect feedback
updates: 2026-02-12: Kickoff with Eng, Security, and Design. Agreed to a weekly owner cadence with a 2-week backup window. Action: PM to produce draft calendar (Sofia).
2026-02-20: Draft calendar shared; Eng requested alignment with runtime release windows to avoid overlap. Added constraint: no owner rotation during major runtime-1.18 deployments.
2026-02-28: Security requested explicit mapping to audit log collection offsets (retain pre-change window + 7 days). Added to acceptance criteria.

2026-03-03: Automation proposal (Slack reminders + PagerDuty for overdue evidence). Engineering recommended implementing a lightweight webhook first; will evolve to an orchestration job in release-2026.04.

2026-03-09: Pilot owners identified for March-April: Liam Chen (week-of-3/15), Maya Patel (week-of-3/22) as backup rotation. Confluence page template created: link=https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/COMPLIANCE/rotating-calendar
2026-03-12: Security review flagged SSO artifact handling for cross-tenant evidence. Added task: standardize SAML metadata storage (ENG-4821 dependency).
open_questions: Should owner rotation be weekly or bi-weekly to minimize context switching for engineering owners?
How do we handle evidence that spans multiple rotation windows (e.g., long-running logs)?
Do we allow temporary delegation to contractors outside the roster during emergencies?
